podcast.body: Released in January 1978, "Wuthering Heights" was Kate Bush's first single from her debut album, "The Kick Inside," recorded when she was barely 19. It stood out as unusual even during the punk years due to her unique singing style and range, its lyrical basis on an Emily Brontë novel, and her distinct vocal delivery, described as "howled." "Kate Bush and Wuthering Heights, the first single from her album, The Kick Inside, recorded when she was barely 19."

srcs.source: The Ongoing History of New Music

podcast.body: This was the first single released from Kate Bush's debut album, *The Kick Inside*, in January 1978, when she was barely 19. It was considered highly unusual for the punk era due to her distinctive singing style and vocal range, and especially because it was a hit song based on an Emily Brontë novel. "Kate Bush and Wuthering Heights, the first single from her album, The Kick Inside, recorded when she was barely 19."
